title: Klippo Subcategory Prompt Variation Library
source: Additive structured library derived from prompts/prompt_component_tables.json subcategories; existing master prompts remain unchanged.
selection_policy: Select one variation for the exact selected subcategory; avoid the last three choices for that subcategory. Use category-safe actions and only reference-visible details.
global_rules: Preserve the exact visible product identity, shape, colour, pattern, labels, proportions and supplied parts.
Do not invent functions, materials, ingredients, accessories, claims, prices, discounts or results.
Keep actions physically plausible; simplify to a camera-only detail reveal if the reference does not support the action.
Do not force a human, child or animal model; follow the user's explicit model selection and model-safety rules.
No on-screen text, captions, extra logos or watermark unless the user explicitly selected text.

variations.name: Soft Window Reveal
variations.hook: HOOK: Open with the complete women's clothing fit and drape clearly readable; no generic text overlay.
variations.action: Let the selected garment settle naturally after one small step; keep its cut, print and fit unchanged.
variations.detail: DETAIL: Highlight only a genuinely visible women's clothing fit and drape; do not invent parts, materials, features or claims.
variations.camera: CAMERA: Begin wide and make one slow push-in; keep the complete item recognizable.
variations.lighting: LIGHTING: Warm neutral light, consistent across every beat.
variations.closing: CTA / HERO: Return to the same product orientation and lighting for a clean close.
variations.audio: AUDIO: Add only subtle music and SFX that match visible actions; keep music below any selected speech.

variations.name: Macro-to-Hero
variations.hook: HOOK: Open with the complete women's clothing fit and drape clearly readable; no generic text overlay.
variations.action: Show one relaxed front-to-side turn, then return to a clear view of the exact outfit.
variations.detail: DETAIL: Highlight only a genuinely visible women's clothing fit and drape; do not invent parts, materials, features or claims.

variations.audio: AUDIO: Use one soft handling sound only if the handling is visible; no invented effects.
